tools.name: submit_transcription
tools.description: Submit a public video or audio URL (YouTube etc.) for verbatim transcription. Returns a job_id immediately. Transcription takes ~1-10 minutes: poll get_job with the job_id every 30-60 seconds until status is 'done', then call get_job with include_transcript=true. Not for private/internal URLs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check a transcription job. Returns status (queued / working / done / error) and metadata. Set include_transcript=true only once status is 'done' and you actually need the full text in context - transcripts of long videos are large.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List all transcription jobs on your account, newest first.

tools.name: delete_job
tools.description: Permanently delete a finished (done or errored) transcription job and its stored text. Refused while the job is queued or running. This cannot be undone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: submit_transcription · Public sink: submit_transcription · Destructive: delete_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: submit_transcription · Public sink: submit_transcription · Destructive: delete_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
